run.training_boundary_note: Exclusive result dates; same-day rows included only after independently verified FINISHED scores and past kickoffs.

count_model_selection.protocol: Monthly frozen fits. Select Aug 2024-Feb 2025 by per-team MAE; gate Aug 2025-Jun 2026 on improved per-team MAE and Poisson NLL, with total MAE <=102% baseline. Current season through Oct 17 is diagnostic only. Oct 18 is excluded. Historical results are retrospective.
